tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Commodity-Backed Warehouse Token
underlyingAsset: Lesotho state enterprise commodity receipt — mineral ore / agricultural produce stored at certified government warehousing facility
description: Water and Sewerage Company issues warehouse receipt tokens backed by commodities produced or procured by the enterprise. Token holders receive pro-rata claims on certified stored inventory, enabling smallholder suppliers to access immediate liquidity.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Workforce Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Lesotho public sector service contract — vetted suppliers, maintenance contractors and consultants engaged by Water and Sewerage Company
description: Water and Sewerage Company tokenises service contracts with suppliers and independent contractors. Micro-enterprises and artisans can tokenise outstanding invoices as collateral for working-capital loans, eliminating the 90-day government payment delay.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Infrastructure PPP Token
underlyingAsset: Public-private partnership project in Lesotho — managed by Water and Sewerage Company with mandatory 60% local employment quota
description: Water and Sewerage Company issues PPP tokens for capital infrastructure projects. Each token represents fractional participation in project revenue under a concession agreement. Smart contracts automatically enforce local hiring targets before milestone payments are released.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Public Real Estate Asset Token
underlyingAsset: Government-owned land and property portfolio managed by Water and Sewerage Company in Lesotho
description: Water and Sewerage Company tokenises government property assets to unlock dormant balance-sheet value. Citizens can invest from 1 LSL unit and earn rental income proportional to token holdings, converting public assets into inclusive wealth-generation instruments.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Verified Labour Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Daily economic activity of casual workers, contract staff and micro-vendors contracted by Water and Sewerage Company
description: Water and Sewerage Company issues proof-of-work tokens for every verified day of labour performed by casual workers on government contracts. Accumulated tokens build a portable credit score accepted by partner lenders, replacing the collateral requirement for the unbanked workforce.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Capital Project Milestone Token
underlyingAsset: Construction and development project milestones verified by independent engineers at Water and Sewerage Company projects in Lesotho
description: Water and Sewerage Company issues milestone tokens that unlock progress payments only when independent inspectors verify project completion at each gate. This eliminates corruption in public procurement and ensures employment-creating contractors are paid promptly and fairly.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Agricultural Offtake Token
underlyingAsset: Smallholder and commercial farm produce procured by Water and Sewerage Company under government off-take programmes in Lesotho
description: Water and Sewerage Company tokenises forward purchase agreements with smallholder farmers who supply the enterprise. Farmers receive pre-season financing in token form, redeemable at harvest. This removes predatory middlemen and connects subsistence farmers to institutional buyers.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company SME Supply Chain Participation Token
underlyingAsset: Small and medium enterprise contracts awarded by Water and Sewerage Company under preferential procurement policies in Lesotho
description: Water and Sewerage Company tokenises the economic value of SME contracts under its preferential procurement programme. Tokens can be listed on the national digital exchange, enabling impact investors to co-fund local businesses while earning competitive returns.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company SOE Diversified Portfolio ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Diversified exposure to all tokenised assets across Water and Sewerage Company enterprise operations in Lesotho
description: Water and Sewerage Company launches a basket ETF token spanning all 15 tokenised asset classes within its operations. A single token gives retail investors diversified exposure to infrastructure, commodities, labor, SME supply chains and government bonds from 1 LSL unit.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Partial State Equity Token
underlyingAsset: Fractional economic interest in Water and Sewerage Company — Lesotho government retains majority ownership
description: Water and Sewerage Company issues fractional equity tokens representing an economic interest in enterprise profits. The government retains majority control while citizens, pension funds and diaspora investors access ownership stakes from 1 LSL unit, distributing national resource wealth broadly.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company SOE Development Bond Token
underlyingAsset: Sovereign-backed development bond issued by Water and Sewerage Company to finance capital expansion in Lesotho
description: Water and Sewerage Company tokenises government-guaranteed development bonds accessible from 1 LSL unit. Proceeds finance electrification, water, transport or ICT expansion projects. Quarterly coupon payments are streamed directly to token holders' wallets in real time.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Universal Access Financial Inclusion Token
underlyingAsset: Financial inclusion initiative of Water and Sewerage Company targeting unbanked and underserved communities in Lesotho
description: Water and Sewerage Company deploys a universal access token to extend its core services to unbanked rural and peri-urban communities. Women's cooperatives, youth groups and disability enterprises receive preferential allocation at issuance, with minimal KYC via mobile digital identity.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Critical Mineral Royalty Token
underlyingAsset: Lesotho critical mineral royalties and production-sharing revenue from Water and Sewerage Company operations
description: Water and Sewerage Company tokenises the mineral royalty stream from government-owned resource operations. Every citizen holding a royalty token receives a direct share of natural resource revenue, converting extractive industry profits into universal basic wealth distribution.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company Farmer Verification Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Satellite and IoT verified agricultural output records for farmers supplying Water and Sewerage Company in Lesotho
description: Water and Sewerage Company mints an agriculture proof-of-work token for each independently verified farming event — planting, cultivation and harvest — recorded by satellite and IoT sensors. Verified records build a formal credit identity for smallholder farmers with no prior banking history.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Water and Sewerage Company End-to-End Supply Chain Track Token
underlyingAsset: Multi-step supply chain provenance trail from production through to delivery — managed by Water and Sewerage Company in Lesotho
description: Water and Sewerage Company tokenises every custody transfer and logistics event across its supply chain on an immutable ledger. Each step earns employment tokens for transport operators and warehouse workers, creating a traceable, tamper-proof record from source to end consumer.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular
